name: tedtoolkit-hyperframes-tutorials
description: Plan tutorial series and courses, design their shared visual system, then review lesson outlines, script, narrate, storyboard, produce, cover, validate, and package animated HyperFrames tutorials.

interface.longDescription: File-based workflows for planning multi-course tutorial series and individual courses, designing a reusable series visual system, reviewing and approving a lesson narrative outline before scripting, resuming production from verified state, detecting stale artifacts, co-designing scripts and provisional storyboards, generating narration with Fish Audio from a saved voice model ID, finalizing storyboards against verified timing, producing HyperFrames videos and coherent course and lesson covers, and packaging verified offline learner releases.
defaultPrompt: Plan a coherent multi-course tutorial series with explicit graduation, extension, and prerequisite routes.
Design a shared visual system with reusable styles and clear course variation for a tutorial series.
Plan a coherent animated tutorial course with a required Core route, optional Extension routes, a 00.00 course guide, and stable lesson workspaces.
Outline one lesson's narrative spine for review before writing its spoken script.
Resume a partially produced course from its verified state and detect stale artifacts.
Generate narration.wav from an approved narration.txt with Fish Audio.
Write each lesson's script and provisional storyboard from its approved outline, then finalize it against generated narration timing.
Create a coherent course cover system and lesson covers from verified tutorial content.
